senses.gloss: (גּוּן, constr. גּוֹן) m. (גּוּן) surface, color; resemblance.
units: <cite ref="Eruvin 53b:5">Erub. 53ᵇ</cite> (as specimen of elegant language) <he>מאי גַּוַּון טליתך</he> of what color is thy cloak?—

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 90:10">Midr. Till. to Ps. XC</cite>, end <he>מפני מה</he> [<he>בחר</he>] <he>תכלת מכל ג׳</he> why has the blue been preferred to any other color?—Pl. <he>גַּוָּונִים</he>, <he>נִין …</he> <cite ref="Berakhot 6b:24">Ber. 6ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Niddah 24b:54">Nidd. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>ג׳ תנן</he> the Mishnah (III, 2 <cite ref="C01144"><he>גנינים</he></cite>) speaks of variegated colors.
Num. R. s. 12 מינין הרבה וג׳ הרבה many qualities and many colors; a. fr.—Trnsf. כְּגוֹן (cmp. כְּעֵין s. v. עַיִן) like, similar to; for example. כגון ש־ (Chald. כגון ד׳) for instance if, when.
<cite ref="Pesachim 119b:10">Pes. 119ᵇ</cite> <he>כג׳ תמרים וכ׳</he> such things as dates, roasted ears &c.
<cite ref="Pesachim 119b:10">Ib.</cite> <he>כג׳ אורדילאי לי</he> e.g. mushrooms for me.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 101a:7">B. Mets. 101ᵃ</cite> <he>כג׳ דא צריכא רבה</he> something like this was very necessary to be said.
<cite ref="Chullin 84a">Ḥull. 84ᵃ</cite> <he>כג׳ אנו</he> people like ourselves (in our condition).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:2:9">Y. Ber. I, 3ᵇ</cite> top <he>כג׳ אנו שעוסקין וכ׳</he> people like ourselves who are engaged &c.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 108a:10">B. Kam. 108ᵃ</cite> <he>כ׳ שטען וכ׳</he> e.g. if he claims &c.
B. Mets. 69ᵃ כ׳ דאית וכ׳ if he has &c.; a. v. fr.—Denom. גִּוֵּון to color.
<cite ref="Shabbat 140a">Sabb. 140ᵃ</cite> top the egg is put in <he>לגַוֵּון</he> (Ar. <he>לגַוָּאן</he>, Ms. M. <he>לגיאן</he>, O. <he>ליגרון</he>) only for coloring.
